$description: FENAKI design tokens in the W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) format, in three tiers: primitive (raw values), semantic (roles that components use) and component (one component's decisions). Values are CSS strings. Modes: `dark` is the product and the default `$value`; `light` lives in $extensions and is for the newsletter, the sponsor dossier and print only.

primitive.$description: Raw values with neutral names. Components never use them: only semantic and component tokens point here.

color.$description: Palettes by hue. The step is about (100 − L*) × 10, so steps compare across hues.

archivo-narrow.$description: Archivo, falling back to a narrow face where the variable font has not loaded.

semantic.$description: Roles. Components and pages use these (and component tokens), never primitives. Both modes map the same names to different primitives.

background.$description: Surfaces. Tailwind: bg-*, from-*, via-*, to-*.

canvas.$description: Page background: the darkened room. Every screen starts here.

raised.$description: Raised surfaces: the collection hero, search field, license notes, menus, the scrolled header.

muted.$description: Posters without art, secondary buttons, hover fills, dialogs, the player before it loads.

inverse.$description: A fill in the text colour: a selected chip, a tooltip, the light box behind a logo.

translucent.$description: Secondary button fill over images, at the translucent opacity: a warm mid grey that stays legible on light and dark frames.

primary.$description: Primary text and icons, on canvas, raised, muted and info-subtle.

secondary.$description: Metadata (director, duration, year) and secondary copy, on canvas, raised and muted.

inverse.$description: Text over a light still (a still marked «dark text»): the near-black of the light mode's primary text.

on-inverse.$description: Text on an inverse fill (selected chip, tooltip): the page colour.

accent.$description: Accent text (eyebrows, «Ver todo» links, the current page in the header) on canvas, raised and accent-subtle.

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on an accent fill (the primary button label).

on-sponsored.$description: All text on the sponsored fill.

subtle.$description: Decorative hairlines between sections. Never the only edge of a control.

strong.$description: Control borders (inputs, chips, secondary buttons): at least 3:1 on canvas, raised and muted.

inverse.$description: The edge of an inverse fill (selected chip) and of a secondary icon button on hover.

on-sponsored.$description: Outlines on the sponsored fill (the outline button).

accent.$description: Neon pink, the marquee light. The one action colour: primary buttons, active states, the focus ring. Never decoration. Tailwind: bg-accent, fill-accent, accent-accent…

hover.$description: Hover fill of a primary button.

subtle.$description: Tinted ground behind accent text (accent badges such as «Nuevo»).

sponsored.$description: The curtain. Reserved for sponsored collections: their hero and their posters. Nothing else is wine.

info.$description: Silver screen. Legal and informational marks: license route, subtitle badges.

$root.$description: As text on canvas, raised and info-subtle.

subtle.$description: Tinted ground behind info text (info badges).

$root.$description: Form errors and broken embeds in the admin. Always with a word, never colour alone.
The light at the top of the home page: a warm grey, used at the glow opacity.
The page behind a modal dialog, at the scrim opacity.

font.$description: One family, Archivo, in three voices. Tailwind: font-display, font-text, font-mono.

display.$description: Archivo at 75 % width: condensed poster capitals, like a title card. Always uppercase, used with restraint.

text.$description: Archivo at its normal width: headings, controls and copy (the logo keeps Big Shoulders, as outlines).

mono.$description: Archivo with tabular figures, so durations and counts line up.

word-spacing.$description: Extra space between words: Archivo sets its spaces tight.

typography.$description: Type styles by role. Tailwind: text-* (size, line height, weight and tracking together). Pair display styles with font-display, utility styles with font-mono.

display-xl.$description: Collection hero title. One per screen.

display-l.$description: Short title on its page and on the player.

tv.fenaki.sample: Cinco cortos que ganaron el Goya y se pueden ver gratis, de forma legal.

small.$description: License text, player message, chips and rail actions.

tv.fenaki.sample: Se reproduce desde el canal de YouTube de su productora.

meta.$description: Director and secondary metadata, in text-secondary.

meta-strong.$description: Emphasis inside metadata: the sponsor's name in a sponsor credit, bold text in prose.

timecode.$description: Durations, always formatted with Intl (unit: minute).

label.$description: Badges, eyebrows and the sponsor credit label, uppercase.

label-l.$description: Large badges, next to body-size facts (a short's page).

label-s.$description: Year on a typographic poster and the sponsor label.

spacing.$description: The 4px scale, named by Tailwind step (1 = 4px). Tailwind: p-*, m-*, gap-*, inset-*…

0.$description: No space: resets margins and insets.

hair.$description: Between a card's title and its metadata line.

2.$description: Inside controls; poster title to credit.

3.$description: Between chips and buttons; poster padding.

4.$description: Between cards in a rail; minimum page gutter.

radius.$description: Screens are rectangles: corners stay small. Tailwind: rounded-*.

sm.$description: Posters, stills, cards, notes and menus.

md.$description: Panels at card scale: the floating short preview, dialogs, settings panels.

lg.$description: Large surfaces: the heroes (short, collection, showcase), the collection page header and the player.

shadow.$description: Light falls from the screen: shadows are deep and soft in the dark mode. Tailwind: shadow-*.

sm.$description: Small floating controls, such as the expanded rating pill. Cards and posters have no shadow at rest.

md.$description: The home hero, lifted off the page.

lg.$description: Floating panels: the short preview, dialogs, a poster lifted on hover or focus.

focus-ring.$description: Keyboard and TV-remote focus on every interactive element: a dark gap, then a 2px accent ring. Used through the focus-ring utility.

poster.$description: Portrait posters: the typographic poster in the heroes.

still.$description: Stills, the player, the collection hero art and the thumbnail of every short card.

size.$description: Shared dimensions. Used as arbitrary values: size-(--size-icon-md).

sm.$description: Icon in sm buttons, pagination arrows and the header search's clear button.

md.$description: Icon in the search field; checkboxes.

lg.$description: Icon in md buttons and the header magnifier.

column.$description: Narrow column: the footer brand column, the genres menu, a logo or a poster in a preview.

container.$description: Maximum widths for layouts and text measures. Tailwind: max-w-*, w-*.

page.$description: Maximum width of the page content.

article.$description: Maximum width of a short's page.

narrow.$description: A narrow column: forms, account settings, the license note, offer cards.

hero-text.$description: Collection description and short synopsis in the heroes.

prose.$description: Long-form text (legal pages): a comfortable line, wide enough for their tables.

breakpoint.$description: Layout switches. Mobile first: styles apply from this width up. Tailwind: md:, lg:.

md.$description: Hero goes from one to two columns; grids of cards too.

lg.$description: The footer's link columns go from one under another to all in a row; grids of cards from two to four.

fast.$description: Button hover fill and press; the default of every transition.

opacity.$description: Translucency. Tailwind: opacity-*, and colour modifiers such as bg-translucent/(--opacity-translucent).

secondary.$description: Sponsor label on the sponsored fill and poster year.

glow.$description: Strength of the light at the top of the home page.

translucent.$description: Secondary button fill: the translucent colour at this opacity, so the image behind shows through, blurred.

backdrop.$description: The catalog screenshot behind the pre-launch hero: faint, so the text reads over it.

scrim.$description: The page behind a modal dialog: the scrim colour at this opacity.

blur.$description: Backdrop blur for translucent surfaces. Tailwind: backdrop-blur-*.

translucent.$description: Behind translucent secondary buttons and the rating pill: the blur, more than the fill, is what makes them read.

component.$description: One component's decisions, by component. Each is a CSS variable named --{component}-{property}, except where `utility` in $extensions names the Tailwind theme variable it is exposed as (then it is a utility class, such as rounded-control).

control.$description: Buttons, icon buttons, text fields, pagination links and the header search.

radius.$description: Buttons and text fields: pill-shaped. Point it at semantic.radius.sm for squared controls.

label-sm.$description: Button label (sm), in the site header.

label-lg.$description: Button label (lg), in heroes and on the player.

height.$description: Search field height; also its left inset for the icon.

max-width.$description: Search field, and the header search when open.

logo-height.$description: Height of the sponsor's logo in its credit («Presentada por»).

height-lg.$description: Large badge height, next to body-size facts (a short's page).

width.$description: Short card width in rails (16:9 thumbnails).

progress-height.$description: Height of the viewing-progress bar at the foot of a card's image («Seguir viendo» and the history).

title.$description: Short title under a card's image.

perforation-hole.$description: Height of one perforation hole (pitch is twice this).

lift.$description: How far a poster rises on hover or focus.

lift-duration.$description: Poster lift on hover or focus.

rank-number.$description: The big figure behind a Top 10 card.

single.$description: Rank 1 to 9: its digits stand as tall as the card (0.7em at 224px ≈ 157px); the 0.67 line height puts their baseline on the box's bottom edge.

overlap.$description: How far a Top 10 card covers the right side of its rank number.

short-preview.$description: The floating preview of a short card.

delay-open.$description: How long the pointer rests on a short card before its preview opens.

delay-close.$description: Grace time before the preview closes when the pointer leaves, so it can cross from the card to the panel.

duration.$description: The preview grows out of the card's box.

layer.$description: Stacking order: above the sticky header.

rating-pill.$description: The rating buttons' pill, which opens over the buttons beside it.

duration.$description: The pill unfolding from its button and folding back into it.

scale-folded.$description: The pill's width when folded: about the one button it unfolds from.

opacity.$description: Surface of the pill: the buttons beside it show through, blurred.

arrow-size.$description: Side of the square that makes the arrow.

min-height.$description: Minimum height of the home hero with a backdrop image on small screens; from md up it takes the still's 16:9 shape.

poster-width.$description: The featured short's poster in the home hero.

height.$description: Height of the fixed site header: anchors scroll this far below the top.

duration.$description: The header turning from transparent to solid as the page scrolls.

height.$description: Default height of the light at the top of the home page (black behind the header, a lighter grey, then the page background). On the home page a script makes it end at the hero's bottom edge.

max-width.$description: The pre-launch page's column: title, lead and waitlist form.
The column of FENAKI's emails: logo, card and footer.
